### 2026-10-27: Starting out Act II

**0.5h**

Starting out Act II

Turns out I can't create a keyboard with a display  😭✌️ Well, for this first 30 minutes, I planned out what i'm going to make. I'm planning on making a live updated widget. I plan on first making it just show the title of the current song played and time. I also planned what screen I plan to use. I'm planning on using the nice!view screen. I'm also going to use the ESP32-S3-Zero as it's small form factor is definitely something I want
